title: Course registration system slow during peak registration
description: Registration opened at 08:00 for third-year students. Within a few minutes the system was crawling - page loads of 20-40 seconds, some students getting logged out mid-registration. It cleared up around 08:50. Registrar wants to know if it will happen again at 08:00 tomorrow for second-years, which is a larger cohort.

deployment_notes:
No deployments on 2024-09-02.
Last deployment to reg-api was 2024-08-19 (v6.2.0).
Last schema change was 2024-08-04: added table `enrolment_history`
  (2.8M rows imported from the legacy system).

Infrastructure notes:
  - reg-web runs 4 instances, autoscaling disabled (fixed at 4) since 2023.
  - db-reg is a single instance, no read replica.
  - Redis is a shared instance also used by the library system and the
    campus wifi portal.
